exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Such as A and B".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
A より B のほうが〜
options.romaji: A yori B no hou ga 〜

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! A とか B とか matches "Such as A and B".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is A とか B とか.
exercises.explanation: Lists examples or possibilities, similar to "such as A and B."
